Host blood transcriptome in dengue: differential expression, GO enrichment and SVM classification (GSE51808)

2021ICT114

2026-11-14

1 Overview

This notebook runs the full analysis pipeline for the public dataset GEO GSE51808 (whole blood microarray, dengue patients and healthy controls). Each step is a script in the code/ folder. The scripts save figures to figures/ and result tables to results/.

2 Data import

The raw dataset is downloaded from GEO only if it is not already in data/.

if (!file.exists("data/GSE51808.rds")) source("code/01_download_data.R")
gse <- readRDS("data/GSE51808.rds")
cat("Probes:", nrow(Biobase::exprs(gse)),
    "| Samples:", ncol(Biobase::exprs(gse)), "\n")
## Probes: 54715 | Samples: 56

8 SVM classification (Control vs Dengue)

Feature selection is done inside each cross-validation fold, so test samples never influence the selected genes.

source("code/07_classification.R")
